creator_type: parent creator (mother of a girl who appears to be about 7 to 9)
product: Educational products from the Israeli retailer Palphot's "חושים" line: a 36-card reusable maths flash-card set (box titled "חשבון בכיף"), a wooden board with felt hands plus number blocks and cards, a sandglass and marker set, and a day and night routine board with picture magnets and star stickers
disclosure_visible: Caption last line: "זה בשיתוף @palphot". Nothing visible on screen. Instagram paid-partnership label: 0.
format: mother talking to camera with products held up, cut with top-down footage of her daughter using them, voiceover and burned-in subtitles

hook_0_3s.opening_image: Close shot of a dark-haired woman with the lower half of her face hidden behind a wooden board with coloured hands and a small blue box held up at the side; at 1.4 s the shot cuts to a top-down view of a child's arm sticking magnets on a routine board on the floor.
hook_0_3s.spoken: 0.0-5.4 s (machine transcript): "מי שמסכים איתי שילדים צריכים ללמוד דרך חוויה, תעשו מהר לייק כדי שידע שאתם איתי"
hook_0_3s.on_screen_text: White bold subtitle: "מי שמסכים איתי" at 0 s, then "שילדים צריכים" (1 s), "ללמוד דרך חוויה" (2 s), "תעשו מהר לייק" (3 s).
hook_0_3s.reason_to_keep_watching: Interpretation: opens with an opinion plus a direct ask to like the video, which gets agreement first and the products second. The cut at 1.4 s to a child's hands on a colourful board also keeps the eye busy.

how_value_is_shown: Voiceover and subtitle name the learning use of each product (maths practice with different difficulty levels, hands to solve sums, a routine board that teaches independence), while the footage shows each used on the floor.
demonstration: Child writes answers on the cards, lays tiles on the wooden board, and places magnets on the routine board.
proof: A child using the products on camera. No results, ratings or comparisons. Caption claims the prices are fair.
emotion: Warm and casual; the mother laughs with her daughter in one shot.
personal_story: She says they are trying the products at home now ("שאנחנו מתנסים בהם בבית עכשיו", machine transcript).
selling_language: Caption: "המחירים כל כך הוגנים!"; "יש לכם קופון באתר של פלפוט". Voiceover: "אני אקפיץ לכם יחד עם קופון" (machine transcript).
captions_on_screen: White bold word-chunk subtitles of the speech at lower centre of frame throughout, no extra headline.
editing_rhythm: About 19 shots in 47 s (average about 2.5 s), mostly hard cuts between the mother showing a product and top-down use.
ending_and_cta: Last 3 s: the routine board hanging by its rope handles with subtitle "אני אקפיץ אליכם". CTA: comment on the video and her bot sends a link with a coupon (voiceover, caption); caption also says the products are sold in various toy stores.
price_or_code: A coupon for the retailer's site is promised via DM after a comment; no code or price shown.
convincing: Interpretation: the child is actually handling each product on camera, the mother's tone is casual, and the comment-for-link bot is simple.
weak_or_overproduced: Interpretation: opening with a like request is generic, and the four different product types in 47 s leave little time for any single one to land. The collaboration is labelled only at the bottom of the caption.
lumebook_lesson: Interpretation: the first-frame product hold-up to the lens, then a top-down cut of a child using it, then a comment-for-link CTA is a repeatable pattern with a phone. For LumeBook the top-down page-turn and the hold-to-camera cover could fill the same role.
solo_without_child: partly: the mother-to-camera parts work alone, half the footage needs the child
not_verified: Whether the products were gifted or only a fee was paid; the child's age (estimated visually); the exact coupon terms; any music.
